'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**[[M23 campaign (2022–present)|M23 campaign]]
***[[2025 Uvira offensive]]
****At least 22 people are killed when a boat carrying people attempting to escape [[Rwanda Defence Force|Rwanda]]-backed [[March 23 Movement|M23 rebels]] in the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] across [[Lake Edward]] towards [[Uganda]] capsizes. Eight survivors are found by the local [[civil society]]. [https://apnews.com/article/congo-boat-capsizes-m23-rebel-advance-rwanda-44551419da669ec5095ec3129f955ca6 (AP)]
***The [[Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|Congolese Army]] abandons their positions in [[Lubero]], [[North Kivu]], with reports that the deserting soldiers have looted a market and shops in town. The military has ordered the [[desertion|deserters]] to return to their posts within 12 hours or face criminal action. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/congo-army-runaways-loot-sow-panic-north-kivu-town-2025-02-20/ (Reuters)]
*[[War against the Islamic State]]
**[[Islamic State insurgency in Puntland]]
***[[Puntland counter-terrorism operations]]
****[[Puntland Security Force|Puntland security forces]], with [[Close air support|air support]] from the  [[United Arab Emirates Air Force|United Arab Emirates]], launch a major offensive in the [[Cal Miskaad]] mountains, allegedly killing at least 44 [[Islamic State – Somalia Province|IS–Somalia]] militants and seizing control of the areas of Dhasaq, Qurac, and Damdamle, in [[Bari Region]], [[Puntland]], [[Somalia]]. [https://garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/puntland-forces-seize-key-mountain-strongholds-from-isis-in-major-offensive (Garowe Online)] [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/Feb/200336/puntland_forces_uae_airstrikes_kill_44_isis_fighters_in_major_offensive.aspx (Hiiraan Online)]
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**[[2025 Catatumbo clashes]]
***Four bombings and shooting attacks take place across different police facilities and toll areas in [[Cúcuta]], [[Norte de Santander Department]], [[Colombia]], leaving one police officer injured. Authorities in Norte de Santander and Cúcuta declare a curfew across the city for the following day. [https://cnnespanol.cnn.com/2025/02/20/colombia/toque-de-queda-cucuta-ataques-explosivos-orix (CNN Colombia)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[January 2025 Gaza war ceasefire|2025 Gaza war ceasefire]], [[Gaza war hostage crisis]]
***[[Hamas]] releases the bodies of [[Kidnapping of the Bibas family|Shiri Bibas, Ariel Bibas, Kfir Bibas]], and [[Oded Lifshitz]], who were all kidnapped from their homes in [[Nir Oz]] kibbutz, [[Israel]], on [[Nir Oz attack|October 7, 2023]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/shiri-ariel-and-kfir-bibas-oded-lifshitz-named-as-the-slain-hostages-to-return-thursday/#openwebComments (''The Times of Israel'')]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[2025 Shabelle attacks]]
***[[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab]] launches a coordinated attack on four [[Somali Armed Forces|Somali military]] bases in [[Middle Shabelle]], [[Somalia]], killing and wounding dozens of [[Somali National Army|soldiers]]. [[Federal Government of Somalia|Somali authorities]] say they repelled the attack, killing at least 130 militant fighters. [https://www.mepanews.com/somalide-askeri-uslere-es-zamanli-saldirilar-1-71085h.htm (Mepa News)] [https://garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/somali-army-repels-al-shabaab-attack-kills-130-in-middle-shabelle-region (Garowe Online)]
*[[2025 Bat Yam bus bombings]]
**Three empty buses [[Bus bombing|explode]] in what is suspected as an attempted [[terrorist attack]] in [[Bat Yam]], [[Israel]]. Devices planted on two other buses failed to detonate, according to [[Israel Police|police]]. No casualties are reported. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwydln190xqo (BBC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[French military withdrawal from West Africa (2022–present)|French military withdrawal from West Africa]]
**The [[French Armed Forces|French military]] hands over control of their last [[military base]] in [[Ivory Coast]] to the [[Armed Forces of the Republic of Ivory Coast|country's military]]. [[France|French]] [[Minister of the Armed Forces (France)|armed forces minister]] [[Sébastien Lecornu]] says that 80 French [[Military personnel|servicemember]]s will remain in the country to advise and train the Ivorian army.
